provenance.observation: protected=false; classic protection disabled; required status-check enforcement off

evidence_for: No review submissions were observed for PR #309.
Promotion Control evaluated PR #309 as DENIED with observed independent approvals=0 and required=1.

A predecessor mismatch had already been observed for PR #304.
evidence_against: No unsafe scientific/runtime claim promotion caused by PR #309 was established.
The exact ruleset, permission or bypass actor enabling merge remains unobserved.
falsifier: Create a synthetic non-draft PR with zero independent approvals: Promotion Control must DENY and the server must reject merge; after one qualifying independent approval and required checks, only the authorized manual path may become eligible.
next_probe: Inspect repository rulesets, bypass actors and required check identities when an observable settings surface exists; then execute synthetic zero-approval blocked-merge test.

mitigation.containment: claim_allowed=false; observed merge is not claim promotion evidence
mitigation.server_action: bind independent review and exact required assurance checks to server-side merge eligibility
mitigation.rollback: preserve Git history; revert only unsupported governance/configuration assertions

closure_gate.criterion: zero-independent-approval PR is DENIED by policy and provably blocked server-side
closure_gate.evidence_needed: ruleset/protection snapshot + bypass actor state + exact required-check identity + synthetic blocked-merge receipt
closure_gate.falsifier: any zero-approval policy-DENIED PR remains mergeable or is merged through an unreceipted path

review_or_expiry: EVENT_TRIGGERED on promotion workflow, branch protection, ruleset, review requirement, bypass permission, required-check identity or merge-path change

detector.signal: Promotion Control decision + submitted review count + observed server merge outcome
detector.threshold: any DENIED decision with zero required approvals followed by merge, or any absent server-side binding
detector.false_positive: an explicitly authorized and separately receipted emergency bypass is initially flagged
detector.false_negative: a policy-DENIED change reaches main without reconciliation
detector.evidence_needed: PR state/reviews + policy run/job/log + merge commit + governance snapshot

adaptive_control.baseline: PR304 established the first observed mismatch
adaptive_control.delta: PR309 establishes recurrence and raises recurrence_risk while preserving exact mechanism as TOKEN_VAZIO
adaptive_control.justification: two distinct PRs show denied/missing-approval policy evidence with merges observed
adaptive_control.rollback: downgrade recurrence classification only if one cited event is disproved by authoritative history
adaptive_control.retest: synthetic zero-approval PR must be unmergeable server-side

corrective_control.symptom: zero-review PR merged while Promotion Control returned DENIED
corrective_control.mechanism_hypothesis: server-side merge eligibility is not bound to Promotion Control/independent approval in the observed path
corrective_control.before_after_test: before: DENIED+0 approvals did not prevent observed merge; after: identical condition must be rejected by server

maintenance.measured_condition: recurrence observed; classic protection disabled; exact ruleset/bypass state unresolved

safety_assurance.data_acquisition: PR/review history, policy run/job/log, branch governance and merge commit
safety_assurance.analysis: separate correct policy decision from actual server enforcement
safety_assurance.system_reassessment: recheck after every governance change and after any denied merge event
safety_assurance.corrective_trigger: DENIED followed by merge, missing required context, or bypass without explicit receipt

learning.recurrence_check: every merge of a policy-governed PR must reconcile policy result, approvals and server eligibility

lifecycle.environment_exposure: GitHub-hosted runner + GitHub merge service + repository governance configuration
lifecycle.retirement_revalidation_criteria: close only after server-side blocked-merge evidence; reopen on any governance change or recurrence

priority_axes_basis: Integer 0..3 engineering priority classification based on repeated promotion-boundary mismatch; not a physical measurement.
